id: a1b2c3d4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab
status: test
description: Detects a high number of failed Kerberos TGT requests (Event ID 4768) from a single source IP targeting domain controllers within a short time window, indicative of credential stuffing attacks.

  - LogonType
  - Status
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate high volume authentication attempts (e.g., after password reset)
level: high
